title: Smack effects
brief: Retro 1930s cartoon 'smack' click effects for Manita (app + web), cream/ink/red palette

artboards.title: POW star
artboards.tradeoff: Classic comic impact: jagged star with a word; very readable, the most 'loud'

artboards.title: Rubber-hose impact lines
artboards.tradeoff: 1930s ink look: thick tapered motion lines, little stars and a dust puff; subtle and elegant

artboards.title: Dizzy stars + bonk
artboards.tradeoff: Cartoon 'bonk': ring of spinning little stars and a bump; most charming, less punchy

artboards.title: Ink doodles (50s b&w)
artboards.tradeoff: Black-and-white hand-drawn cartoon marks (ticks, sparkles, zigzags, puffs, !!, swirls); expressive and on-style; busier on wild streaks

artboards.title: Brush smack (reference timing, 50s ink)
artboards.tradeoff: Reference sequence (tick ring → rays → jagged smack outline → faint ring) in tapered dip-pen ink; compact and gone in ~0.5 s

artboards.title: Cel smack (5 ink drawings)
artboards.tradeoff: Five distinct hand-inked drawings swapped frame by frame (thin ticks → bold ticks → big wedges → jagged star → faint ticks), ~1.4 hands wide, gone in ~0.3–0.4 s; the jagged star only on fast streaks
